title: I accidentally logged hundreds of thousands of phone calls to military bases
summary: A security researcher discovered and documented a vulnerability in telephone number routing systems where they accidentally intercepted hundreds of thousands of phone calls destined for military bases, related to E.164 number formatting and ARPA domain hijacking in the telecommunications infrastructure.
problem_solved: Exposes a critical security flaw in telephone number routing infrastructure that allows unauthorized interception of sensitive military communications through DNS/ARPA zone manipulation.
why_valuable: Highlights serious vulnerabilities in telecommunications infrastructure with national security implications, demonstrating how misconfigured E.164 routing and ARPA domains can lead to accidental interception of classified military communications.
